title: Search the person's local email
description: Search the mail the person synced into the DSphere Agent Email panel from their own IMAP account (stored locally through the Native Agent).
guidance: Matches subjects, sender and recipient names and addresses, message bodies, and attachment names and text; plain words match anywhere, and from:, to:, subject:, body: or attachment: narrow one term (quote phrases: subject:"quarterly report"); is:unread, is:read, is:flagged and has:attachment filter; after:YYYY-MM-DD and before:YYYY-MM-DD bound the sent date and newer_than:30d or older_than:2w count back from now (d, w, m, y). Results are newest first with opaque message ids, an excerpt whose matched text is wrapped in ** and attachment names. It searches only what the panel has synced (the newest messages of each synced folder) and never contacts the mail server; indexed and pendingBodies say how much is searchable. It never returns account settings or passwords. When configured is false the person has not set up the Email panel yet.

inputSchema.description: A search over the locally synced mail.

query.description: Search words and operators, for example: invoice from:billing@example.com has:attachment newer_than:30d. Optional when a filter field is given.

from.description: Only mail whose sender name or address contains this text.

to.description: Only mail whose recipients (To or Cc) have a name or address containing this text.

after.description: Only mail sent on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD, the person's local time).

until.description: Only mail sent on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD, the person's local time).

mailbox.description: Restrict to one folder, by the mailbox value a previous result returned (INBOX for the inbox). Omit to search every synced folder.

limit.description: How many results to return; default 10.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of the same search.

configured.description: Whether the person has set up an account in the Email panel.

available.description: Whether the local mail store is reachable now (it needs the Native Agent).

mailbox.description: Folder the message is in; pass it as mailbox to search that folder only.

anyOf.description: A mail address with its display name.

name.description: Display name; empty when the message gave none.

from.description: Sender, or null when the message has none.

items.description: A mail address with its display name.

name.description: Display name; empty when the message gave none.

date.description: Sent date as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

excerpt.description: Text around the match; matched text is wrapped in **.

matchedFields.description: Which parts of the message matched.

attachments.description: Attachments by name, at most ten.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null when there are no more.

indexed.description: How many messages are stored and searchable by their headers.

pendingBodies.description: How many stored messages still wait for their bodies (their bodies are not searchable yet).
